instruction: Please help me turn on the setting that displays seconds in the system clock on the top bar.

metadata.explanation: This task asks to enable seconds display in the system clock, an OS-level panel setting that is infeasible to validate programmatically. Similar complexity to the original battery percentage task.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible' marker for this task
The instruction requires enabling seconds display in the Ubuntu system clock (GNOME panel setting), which is an OS-level UI configuration
There is no reliable programmatic way to verify that seconds are displaying in the system panel/top bar
The 'infeasible' function is the appropriate choice for OS panel configurations that cannot be validated programmatically
This is consistent with similar infeasible tasks like battery percentage display in the system tray
